text:
This composition looks like a maraging steel of the C300 or C350 type, with Ni 18%, Co 15%, Mo 4% and Ti 1.5%. That Co and Ti level is close to the 350 grade, which has about 12% Co, 4.2% Mo and 1.6% Ti and a yield strength of roughly 2400 MPa. The very low Al and the higher Co suggest a high-strength variant, so I estimate about 2400 MPa. This is an estimate from grade comparison, not a calculation.
